trace.question: What is the average of the up votes and the average user age for users creating more than 10 posts?
trace.evidence: creating more than 10 post refers to Count (UserId) > 10; average of the up votes = Divide (Sum(UpVotes), Count (UserId)); average age = Divide (Sum(Age), Count(UserId))

attempts.sql:
SELECT SUM(u.UpVotes) * 1.0 / COUNT(u.Id) AS avg_upvotes,
       SUM(u.Age) * 1.0 / COUNT(u.Id) AS avg_age
FROM users u
WHERE u.Id IN (
    SELECT p.OwnerUserId
    FROM posts p
    GROUP BY p.OwnerUserId
    HAVING COUNT(p.Id) > 10
)

trace.final_sql:
SELECT SUM(u.UpVotes) * 1.0 / COUNT(u.Id) AS avg_upvotes,
       SUM(u.Age) * 1.0 / COUNT(u.Id) AS avg_age
FROM users u
WHERE u.Id IN (
    SELECT p.OwnerUserId
    FROM posts p
    GROUP BY p.OwnerUserId
    HAVING COUNT(p.Id) > 10
)
trace.answer: For users who created more than 10 posts, the average upvotes is about 182.3 and the average user age is about 9.1.
